scope_note: This file registers only the mechanically decidable predicates. It is not the inventory of the naming contract; every normative naming clause, including the ones enforced by registry closure, schema type or human review, is enumerated in coverage_matrix.

rules.predicate: permission booleans end _allowed; obligation booleans end _required; reject allow_/require_/requires_/deny_/force_

exceptions.reason: The account_registration_evidence_summary records presence without echoing secret material, so `*_present` is the registered form here.

rules.predicate: counts use _count, bytes use _bytes; reject _len, _length, and _size
Arkret-owned symbolic enum literals use snake_case

exceptions.external_anchor: The external specification or codepoint recorded by the owning suite registry

rules.enforcement_scope: The predicate decides snake_case for every literal it is handed; deciding which enums are Arkret-owned is registry work and is not yet complete, so only registered non-snake literals are currently swept.

rules.predicate: $defs use snake_case; Arkret-owned PascalCase type names fold acronym segments as ordinary words; OpenAPI components use registered structural wrapper suffixes

exceptions.reason: This schema mirrors OpenAPI PascalCase component names one-for-one.

rules.enforcement_scope: The predicate decides acronym folding, stacked wrapper words and rejected wrapper roles; distinguishing a domain subject from a wrapper role is registry-driven via rejected_wrapper_words.

rules.predicate: machine reasons use reason_code or <domain>_reason_code; protocol errors use error_code

Arkret-owned names use complete canonical domain words and the default Arkret namespace; reject shortened aliases and redundant product-qualified aliases registered by canonical-lexeme-registry.json on word boundaries in snake_case, PascalCase and dotted symbols

exceptions.reason: An external standard literal, DNS name or opaque externally owned identifier payload is not an Arkret-owned contract name and remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
exceptions.external_anchor: The owning external specification, registry or identifier namespace recorded by the enclosing contract

rules.enforcement_scope: The registry closes every adjudicated ordinary-word alias and the predicate sweeps schema properties, type names, enum values, registry symbols, fixtures and normative JSON examples. Introducing a new compact token requires classifying it under one of the registry's abbreviation authorities; ordinary word length alone never authorises shortening.

rules.predicate: evidence is reserved for a polymorphic container spanning at least two material families
rules.enforcement_scope: The predicate rejects single-material `*_evidence` stems; per-occurrence adjudication stays in evidence-material-audit.json because it needs the material inventory.

rules.predicate: artifact filenames are kebab-case and category/provenance match actual data shape and generation flow
allowlist/denylist arrays use allowed_/denied_; scope differences use role prefixes
reject Arkret wire fields and Arkret-owned type names ending _hash/_hashes or using hash/hashes/hash_profile/hash_algorithm; the canonical self-describing digest type is named digest

exceptions.reason: The ak.key.verification.* to-device family mirrors the Matrix m.key.verification SAS payload field-for-field so verification transcripts stay byte-comparable with the external protocol.

mimi_room_update_request_body projects RFC 9420 GroupContext verbatim; its siblings mls_group_id and epoch are GroupContext names as well, so renaming only the transcript field would break the projection.
ServiceWebvhInceptionParameters mirrors the did:webvh method parameter object byte-for-byte because the field is part of the externally defined DID log hash chain.
exceptions.external_anchor: did:webvh v1.0 DID method parameters nextKeyHashes

rules.enforcement_scope: The predicate decides the token; every retained occurrence must carry an exact-path exception or a debt entry.

exact_path_exceptions.name: hashes
exact_path_exceptions.reason: Matrix m.key.verification SAS interop field, retained verbatim.

exact_path_exceptions.name: confirmed_transcript_hash
exact_path_exceptions.reason: RFC 9420 GroupContext field projected verbatim into the MIMI interop surface.

exact_path_exceptions.name: nextKeyHashes
exact_path_exceptions.reason: did:webvh method parameter retained verbatim inside the annotated external-literal parameter object.
exact_path_exceptions.external_anchor: did:webvh v1.0 DID method parameters nextKeyHashes

rules.enforcement_scope: No token-level predicate exists; classification-field-registry.json is the only enforcement surface. The predicate only rejects double-axis suffixes.

rules.predicate: resolved identifier terminals require semantic role plus _id, _did, _uri, or _kid; subject-class qualifiers such as service remain orthogonal
rules.enforcement_scope: naming_contracts.py resolves every schema property terminal and combines generic grammars with exact-path external-literal and closed-union exceptions from identifier-role-suffix-registry.json.

rules.predicate: resolved object arrays use the shortest unambiguous plural semantic role; collective nouns and pagination object shapes require exact registry rows
rules.enforcement_scope: naming_contracts.py resolves object-array terminals independently of identifier representations; collection-naming-registry.json closes collective/mass nouns, grammar operators, irregular plurals, and named pagination object structure by exact path.

rules.predicate: reject every declared JSON Schema property name that is not snake_case; a leading $ marks a reserved grammar directive key and the remainder is still judged

exceptions.reason: An object that mirrors an external specification verbatim declares x-arkret-external-literal-object on its own schema node. Keeping the fact in the schema is what makes the exemption exact: it covers only the properties that node declares and cannot be reached through $ref, a shared type name or a same-named property elsewhere.
exceptions.external_anchor: The external specification named by the annotation's specification member, pinned by its https anchor fragment

rules.enforcement_scope: The predicate decides the name; the schema-level x-arkret-external-literal-object annotation decides which exact objects sit outside the Arkret lexicon. A fully snake_case marker may still be required by NC-IDROLE-001 for an external literal such as RFC 9457 instance.
